title: Squad model calls
description: The agents' model calls during cycles: how many, how fast, how big, and where the time goes.

options.content: Every model call the agents make during a cycle, as each agent reports it (OpenTelemetry → the collector → Prometheus), labelled with the engine that served it. Engine replays, such as the TensorFold comparison, call the engine directly and are not here. These are exact counts, sums and averages. Calls recorded before the engine label existed (#2260) show as "unlabelled": every one of them was served by Ollama.

panels.title: Model calls
panels.description: Calls in the selected time range.

targets.expr: sum (sum by (exported_instance, role, task_type, model, engine, long) (last_over_time(squadops_llm_call_seconds_count{model=~"$model", role=~"$role", engine=~"$engine"}[$__range])) - (sum by (exported_instance, role, task_type, model, engine, long) (last_over_time(squadops_llm_call_seconds_count{model=~"$model", role=~"$role", engine=~"$engine"}[10m] offset $__range)) or sum by (exported_instance, role, task_type, model, engine, long) (last_over_time(squadops_llm_call_seconds_count{model=~"$model", role=~"$role", engine=~"$engine"}[$__range])) * 0))

panels.title: Tokens generated
panels.description: Completion tokens, summed over every call in the range.

targets.expr: sum (sum by (exported_instance, role, task_type, model, engine, long) (last_over_time(squadops_llm_completion_tokens_sum{model=~"$model", role=~"$role", engine=~"$engine"}[$__range])) - (sum by (exported_instance, role, task_type, model, engine, long) (last_over_time(squadops_llm_completion_tokens_sum{model=~"$model", role=~"$role", engine=~"$engine"}[10m] offset $__range)) or sum by (exported_instance, role, task_type, model, engine, long) (last_over_time(squadops_llm_completion_tokens_sum{model=~"$model", role=~"$role", engine=~"$engine"}[$__range])) * 0))

panels.title: Decode rate, calls of 1,000+ tokens
panels.description: The average of each call's decode rate (tokens a second), over calls of 1,000 completion tokens or more. A short call decodes faster, so the long calls are the comparable figure (#2204).

targets.expr:
sum (sum by (exported_instance, role, task_type, model, engine, long) (last_over_time(squadops_llm_decode_tokens_per_second_sum{model=~"$model", role=~"$role", engine=~"$engine", long="true"}[$__range])) - (sum by (exported_instance, role, task_type, model, engine, long) (last_over_time(squadops_llm_decode_tokens_per_second_sum{model=~"$model", role=~"$role", engine=~"$engine", long="true"}[10m] offset $__range)) or sum by (exported_instance, role, task_type, model, engine, long) (last_over_time(squadops_llm_decode_tokens_per_second_sum{model=~"$model", role=~"$role", engine=~"$engine", long="true"}[$__range])) * 0))
/ (sum (sum by (exported_instance, role, task_type, model, engine, long) (last_over_time(squadops_llm_decode_tokens_per_second_count{model=~"$model", role=~"$role", engine=~"$engine", long="true"}[$__range])) - (sum by (exported_instance, role, task_type, model, engine, long) (last_over_time(squadops_llm_decode_tokens_per_second_count{model=~"$model", role=~"$role", engine=~"$engine", long="true"}[10m] offset $__range)) or sum by (exported_instance, role, task_type, model, engine, long) (last_over_time(squadops_llm_decode_tokens_per_second_count{model=~"$model", role=~"$role", engine=~"$engine", long="true"}[$__range])) * 0)) > 0)

panels.title: Time to first token
panels.description: Average prefill (reading the prompt) plus model load, per call: what a call waits before its first token. On long prompts this is the larger cost, and the decode rate hides it.

targets.expr:
(sum (sum by (exported_instance, role, task_type, model, engine, long) (last_over_time(squadops_llm_prefill_seconds_sum{model=~"$model", role=~"$role", engine=~"$engine"}[$__range])) - (sum by (exported_instance, role, task_type, model, engine, long) (last_over_time(squadops_llm_prefill_seconds_sum{model=~"$model", role=~"$role", engine=~"$engine"}[10m] offset $__range)) or sum by (exported_instance, role, task_type, model, engine, long) (last_over_time(squadops_llm_prefill_seconds_sum{model=~"$model", role=~"$role", engine=~"$engine"}[$__range])) * 0))
/ (sum (sum by (exported_instance, role, task_type, model, engine, long) (last_over_time(squadops_llm_prefill_seconds_count{model=~"$model", role=~"$role", engine=~"$engine"}[$__range])) - (sum by (exported_instance, role, task_type, model, engine, long) (last_over_time(squadops_llm_prefill_seconds_count{model=~"$model", role=~"$role", engine=~"$engine"}[10m] offset $__range)) or sum by (exported_instance, role, task_type, model, engine, long) (last_over_time(squadops_llm_prefill_seconds_count{model=~"$model", role=~"$role", engine=~"$engine"}[$__range])) * 0)) > 0))
+ (sum (sum by (exported_instance, role, task_type, model, engine, long) (last_over_time(squadops_llm_load_seconds_sum{model=~"$model", role=~"$role", engine=~"$engine"}[$__range])) - (sum by (exported_instance, role, task_type, model, engine, long) (last_over_time(squadops_llm_load_seconds_sum{model=~"$model", role=~"$role", engine=~"$engine"}[10m] offset $__range)) or sum by (exported_instance, role, task_type, model, engine, long) (last_over_time(squadops_llm_load_seconds_sum{model=~"$model", role=~"$role", engine=~"$engine"}[$__range])) * 0))
/ (sum (sum by (exported_instance, role, task_type, model, engine, long) (last_over_time(squadops_llm_load_seconds_count{model=~"$model", role=~"$role", engine=~"$engine"}[$__range])) - (sum by (exported_instance, role, task_type, model, engine, long) (last_over_time(squadops_llm_load_seconds_count{model=~"$model", role=~"$role", engine=~"$engine"}[10m] offset $__range)) or sum by (exported_instance, role, task_type, model, engine, long) (last_over_time(squadops_llm_load_seconds_count{model=~"$model", role=~"$role", engine=~"$engine"}[$__range])) * 0)) > 0))

panels.title: Average prompt
panels.description: Average prompt tokens per call. The window is 262,144 for qwen3.8:27b under Ollama (src/squadops/llm/model_registry.py) and 65,536 on TensorFold's recipe.

panels.description: The average decode rate of the calls in each 10-minute bucket, one colour per engine. Long calls (solid) are the comparable figure: the rate falls as output grows. Shorter calls are dashed.
